# Guide context

User-editable source for the Portfolio Guide. Aggregated at build time into `src/lib/guide-context.json`.

## Identity

- **Who:** Aryan Johari — graduate software engineer, Auckland, New Zealand
- **Availability:** Seeking a graduate software engineering role in Auckland from September 2026
- **Site:** Curated project portfolio — selected work with narrative and live demos
- **Work history:** Detailed employment history is ingested from `public/resume.pdf` at build time (not duplicated here)

## Philosophy

I build software that solves real problems — from visual tools to edge systems. I own the full stack: architecture, APIs, and deployment. AI accelerates delivery, but the design and architecture are mine. This portfolio is a curated project index, not a README dump.

## Quick facts

- **Education:** Master of Technology — Computing, Unitec, Auckland (July 2026); BSc Computer Science, University of Mumbai (March 2024)
- **Work eligibility:** Eligible to work in New Zealand
- **Focus areas:** Visual systems, APIs, edge hardware, full-stack delivery

projects.title: Background Studio
projects.summary: Design animated full-screen hero backgrounds in the browser and export the look as reusable JSON.
projects.description: Background Studio is a live WebGL tool for portfolio and landing-page heroes. Upload an image, pick one of fourteen looks or describe a mood, then tune motion and texture while the scene animates on a single canvas. Export preset JSON to reuse the same coefficients on your own site, or save a WebM loop or PNG still. Optional AI mood (when enabled) suggests a look and a small parameter patch; keyw…

projects.title: Sound Visualiser
projects.summary: Turns music, your microphone, or your webcam into live 3D visuals that follow the beat in the browser.
projects.description: Sound Visualiser is a browser-based VJ rig. Play a track, talk into your microphone, or point your webcam at the room, and the whole screen becomes a reactive light show. Rather than just bouncing bars to the volume, it works out whether the music feels calm, groovy or intense, and tries to lock onto the tempo — when it is confident it has found the beat, the visuals step and pulse in time instea…

projects.title: PII Gateway
projects.summary: Self-hosted API that redacts personal data from JSON, text, and batch files before downstream use.
projects.description: PII Gateway is a Docker-first service for teams that want one place to scrub emails, names, and other personal data before it reaches analytics, logs, or third-party tools. Call POST /v1/sanitize for live JSON and free text, or let optional jobs pull PostgreSQL exports and CSV or JSON inbox files on a schedule. A mounted policy file sets entity types and per-field rules; secrets stay in environme…

projects.title: ADA
projects.summary: Local Python agent for edge devices—chat, background goals, RSS ingest, and SEO page publishing.
projects.description: ADA is a headless Python agent you run on your own hardware, such as a Raspberry Pi. One install supports interactive chat, a background worker for queued goals, offline ingest from RSS and Search Console, and deterministic workflows that draft and publish SEO pages to S3. All state lives in a single SQLite database per profile, with allowlisted shell commands and token budgets for cost control.…

projects.title: GSTF — Generator-Specific Temporal Forensics
projects.summary: Video deepfake research that attributes face-swap clips to specific generators, not just real vs fake.
projects.description: GSTF is a research codebase that classifies face-manipulation videos by which synthesis pipeline produced them (for example Real, Deepfakes, or Face2Face on FaceForensics++), rather than only labeling clips real or fake. It trains an R(2+1)D video backbone, then freezes it and learns an ArcFace metric head for sharper generator separation. A second stage studies transfer to the DFDM dataset with…
